description: Translate an SRT or WebVTT subtitle file into another language. Only the cue text is translated; every cue number, timing line and header is copied exactly, and the output is checked to parse back to the same cues and timings, or it is refused unpaid. Body { subtitles, to, from }: up to 50 KB. Workers AI (Llama 3.1 8B) translates the text, so check it before publishing. Price: $0.004 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

from.description: Source language, optional; detected by the model when not given

subtitles.description: The SRT or WebVTT text, up to 50 KB (JSON body field)

to.description: Target language name or code, e.g. German or de

name: translate_subtitles
title: Translate Subtitles
